Impacts (marginal effects) on outcome probabilities

Source: R/impacts.R
psp_impacts.Rd

Computes average direct, indirect (spillover) and total impacts of each regressor on the outcome probabilities, following LeSage and Pace (2009, ch. 10) but accounting for the reduced-form standard deviation of the latent outcome. Impacts are population-averaged: the random effects are integrated out. For ordered models impacts are computed per category (they sum to zero over categories).

Usage

psp_impacts(
  fit,
  draws = NULL,
  scale = c("reduced_form", "lesage_pace"),
  type = c("population", "unit"),
  by_period = FALSE
)

# S3 method for class 'psprobit'
impacts(obj, ...)

Arguments

fit

A fitted psprobit object.

draws

Number of posterior draws to use (default control$impacts_draws of the fit).

scale

"reduced_form" (default) divides by \(s_i\) as above; "lesage_pace" uses \(\phi(m_{it})\) without it, as in the spatialprobit package, for comparison with published results.

type

"population" (default, random effects integrated out) or "unit" (conditional on the random effects; needs effects = "random").

by_period

Logical; also report impacts averaged within each period (the default averages over all observations).

obj

A fitted psprobit object (method for spatialreg::impacts).

...

Unused.

Value

An object of class psp_impacts with draws and a summary table.

Details

With type = "unit" the impacts are instead conditional on the posterior draws of the random effects: \(m_t = S^{-1}(X_t\beta + \alpha)\) and \(s_i^2 = [S^{-1}S^{-\top}]_{ii}\). They describe the sample units rather than the population and use the random-effect draws kept by the sampler (about control$impacts_draws of them).

For regressor \(r\) and period \(t\), $$\partial P(y_{it} = 1) / \partial x_{jt,r} = \phi(m_{it}/s_i)/s_i \, [S^{-1}(\beta_r I + \theta_r W)]_{ij},$$ where \(m_t = S^{-1}X_t\beta\) and \(s_i^2 = (1 + \sigma_\alpha^2) [S^{-1}S^{-\top}]_{ii}\). Direct impacts average the \(i = j\) terms, total impacts average row sums, and indirect = total - direct.

Examples

W <- psp_weights(rook_weights(4, 4), style = "W")
d <- sim_psprobit(W, T = 3, beta = c(0, 1), rho = 0.4, seed = 2)
fit <- psprobit(y ~ x1, data = d, index = c("id", "time"), W = W, impacts = FALSE,
                control = psp_control(iter = 200, warmup = 100, chains = 1, seed = 2))
#> Warning: Possible convergence problems (R-hat > 1.01 or bulk ESS < 100) for: (Intercept), x1, rho, sigma_alpha. Consider more iterations.
psp_impacts(fit, draws = 50)
#> Impacts on P(y = 1) (posterior mean, sd, 95% interval; 50 draws)
#> 
#> direct:
#>      mean     sd  q2.5  q97.5
#> x1 0.1517 0.0314 0.107 0.2208
#> 
#> indirect:
#>       mean     sd    q2.5  q97.5
#> x1 -0.0022 0.0309 -0.0344 0.0815
#> 
#> total:
#>      mean     sd   q2.5  q97.5
#> x1 0.1496 0.0474 0.0914 0.2843
